-Don't forget to make a backup

EDIT 11/3/2017: Please note due to the fact that the Beta patch 1.2 came out those who are playing the game in a different language, I modified the files so it can be easier to override.

- After choosing which version framed butterflies insects display you want (4 versions to choose from black, brown, beige and tan) then override in the assigned folders, into your Content and Maps folder.
- The Furniture.xnb goes into your TileSheets folder (furniture.ja-JP if you play the game in Japanese) & (furniture.zh-CN if you play the game in Chinese).
